title: Card payments fail due to provider timeouts
summary: Customers cannot pay by card. payment-service shows massive timeouts when calling PayGate. No other major anomalies were noticed.
diagnostic_hints: compare latency and errors across payment providers
verify whether failures are isolated to PayGate

title: payments/create latency spike caused by reporting load
summary: Response time for /payments/create increased to 5-7 seconds. DB CPU is high and reporting-service runs many long queries. Some users receive 504 from api-gateway.
likely_affected: customers creating payments and downstream services depending on the same database resources
diagnostic_hints: correlate DB CPU with payment latency
verify whether reporting load is starving transactional queries

title: Top-up confirmation emails are not delivered
summary: Users do not receive top-up confirmation emails. Money is credited successfully and balances are correct. notification-service shows intermittent SMTP connection errors.
signals: users do not receive top-up confirmation emails
likely_affected: users waiting for top-up confirmation notifications
diagnostic_hints: check SMTP provider connectivity and recent failures
compare notification enqueue vs delivery counts
confirm business flow succeeded despite notification degradation

title: Mobile login failures caused by token signature errors
summary: Some customers cannot log in via the mobile app. auth-service returns 401 errors and logs mention invalid token signatures. Other services do not show large-scale failures.
signals: some customers cannot log in via the mobile app
diagnostic_hints: check token signing and verification configuration
compare recent auth deployments or key rotations
verify whether failures are isolated to mobile-issued tokens
